name: What is sewage cleanup and why is it necessary?

mainEntity.name: What is sewage cleanup and why is it necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sewage cleanup is the process of safely removing hazardous wastewater, decontaminating affected areas, and restoring properties damaged by sewage overflows. It's crucial because sewage contains bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens that pose serious health risks. Proper cleanup prevents illness, structural damage, and eliminates unpleasant odors, ensuring a safe and hygienic environment. This service requires specialized equipment and expertise to handle biohazards effectively and prevent cross-contamination.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewage cleanup involves safely removing hazardous wastewater, decontaminating areas, and restoring properties to prevent health risks and further damage.
